sections.bio:
I am Ziaur Rahaman, Finance & Operations Leader, Entrepreneur, and Founder & CEO of Worklance Connect (worklance.co.in).
 
Over 10+ years in corporate finance, I have led teams, managed multi-crore vendor payment operations, and built finance functions from the ground up across India's leading organisations in hospitality and health retail.
 
Leadership, for me, has never been a title. It has been a responsibility to my team, my organisation, and the outcomes we deliver together.
 
That decade of leading people and processes taught me something critical: the right person in the right role changes everything.
 
That belief became Worklance Connect.
 
Today, I lead a mission-driven company dedicated to transforming how India hires building a seamless, transparent, and mutually beneficial bridge between exceptional candidates and forward-thinking companies.
 
We are not just filling positions. We are shaping careers and building organisations.
 
Great leaders build great teams. That is exactly what we help India's businesses do every single day.
 
We are growing. We are building. And we are just getting started.
 
Leadership · Expertise · Vision Team Leadership · Finance & Operations · Modern Recruitment · Workforce Solutions · Talent Strategy · Business Development · Entrepreneurship · Pan-India Staffing 
 
📍 Kolkata, India · Founder & CEO, Worklance Connect · worklance.co.in

posts.text:
I’m building something I genuinely believe businesses need. 

As a founder, one thing I’ve realized is that having a great business idea is not enough.

You need the right people to turn that idea into reality.

And honestly, hiring the right people is still a huge headache for many founders — especially when you’re just starting out.

That’s why I’m building Worklance Connect 

The idea is simple:

Instead of founders spending countless hours searching for candidates, managing recruiters, following up, and building teams…

We take that headache off their plate.

From hiring and bulk recruitment to building complete teams — we’re working towards creating a recruitment ecosystem that actually helps growing businesses.

But I don’t want Worklance Connect to be just another recruitment company.

I want to build a strong network of founders, recruiters and talented people where everyone can connect, help each other and grow together.

We’re still at the beginning.
There’s a lot to build.
A lot to learn.
And probably a lot of mistakes to make. 😅

But that’s the exciting part.

This is what I’m building. And this is only the beginning.

I’d love to know — if you’re a founder, what’s the biggest challenge you face when building your team? 👇

- Ziaur Rahaman, Founder & CEO

A strong business needs a strong team. Period.

Whether you’re building a new startup, running a small business, or managing a growing company, one thing remains the same the right people can make your business grow faster.

But building a strong team is not easy.

Finding the right candidates, screening profiles, conducting interviews, managing hiring requirements, and ensuring the right fit can become a major headache for business owners and founders.

That’s exactly where Worklance Connect comes in. 

At Worklance, we take the hiring headache off your shoulders so you can focus on what matters most growing your business.

You simply tell us:
👉 What kind of team you need
👉 Your hiring requirements
👉 Your preferred timeline
👉 Your budget

And we work on building the right team according to your business needs and budget.

Whether you need 1 employee or an entire team, we’re here to support your hiring journey.

You focus on your business.
We focus on building your team.

Because at the end of the day, your growth starts with the right people.

— Ziaur Rahaman 
Founder & CEO, Worklance Connect 
Hire Smarter. Grow Faster.
